alternative.meaning: A bring-up checklist account: a seven-segment generic fixture assembles, separates into command, access and observation groups, then separates Estimate from Run, connecting Ada's firmware and the fixture she built to the unresolved radio observation and the projected-versus-observed distinction.

1 / Prepare

Ada Mensah. Code meets the bench.

For embedded firmware roles. On Mosslink, I wrote the firmware, scheduled power states and built the bring-up fixture. My lesson: a firmware decision needs a physical observation.

How does a firmware decision become something you can check?

Seven solid fixture segments assemble into a generic bench fixture. Explanatory geometry, not a reconstruction of my wiring or hardware.

See the middle · Evidence & contact

2 / Observe

A signal can expose a problem.

A current trace showed the radio staying awake after a failed transmission. No cause, fix or later resolution is confirmed. The fixture separates command, access and observation; it does not stand in for a measured trace.

The same fixture segments open into command, fixture and observation groups. This is an explanation of the work, not a recorded test sequence.

3 / Record

An observation gives a claim its limits.

Two years is a battery projection from bench current readings and an assumed reporting cycle. The longest run was 72 hours. No field endurance or weather testing supports a two-year claim.

The Estimate and Run segments separate, then return to the fixture: different evidence supports different claims.

before.text:
ADA MENSAH / LOCAL CONCEPT STUDY

From firmware
to observation.

Three scroll sketches. Each has an opening, a middle and an ending carried by one tangible object. Geometry is explanatory; it does not reconstruct Mosslink or depict test evidence.

01 / Bring-up checklist
The bring-up fixture ↗

Command, access and observation separate from the same solid fixture. Recommended: closest to the fixture Ada built and the work a hiring manager needs to understand.

02 / State table
The power-state assembly ↗

A generic sensor assembly separates planning from observation, using a labelled teaching loop.

03 / Timing diagram reading
The observation loom ↗

Probe connectors order the relationship between command, observation and an open question, without invented timings or traces.

Choose the story structure first. Typography, colour and final wording will have their own review.
